scope: Post-work audit — TheFixer fix for work-backlog repo selection

findings.title: BugDetail calls onUpdate which is not in component props — guaranteed crash on submit
findings.description: BugDetailProps declares only bug and onClose. handleSubmitToOrchestrator calls onUpdate(updated) on line 124 which does not exist in scope. This is a TypeScript compile error and a guaranteed runtime ReferenceError on every successful orchestrator submission.
findings.recommendation: Add onUpdate: (updated: BugReport) => void to BugDetailProps and destructure from props.

findings.title: FR-REPO-SELECTION does not exist in any specification
findings.description: Six // Verifies: FR-REPO-SELECTION comments reference a requirement ID that does not exist in Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md or any other spec document. Violates architecture rule: specs are source of truth.
findings.recommendation: Write proper FR spec entry (e.g. FR-096) and update all traceability comments.

findings.title: API-supplied repo URLs rendered and submitted without validation
findings.description: Repo names/URLs from repos.list() API are merged into dropdown and passed to orchestrator without any URL scheme or domain validation. A compromised or poisoned API response could inject attacker-controlled repo URLs.
findings.recommendation: Validate repo URLs match ^https://github.com/ pattern before accepting.

findings.title: Stored target_repo value passed to orchestrator unvalidated
findings.description: bug.target_repo and fr.target_repo from DB records are used as dropdown values and submitted to orchestrator without URL validation. Combined with no-auth (SEC-001), any attacker can set target_repo to a malicious URL.
findings.recommendation: Validate target_repo matches expected GitHub URL pattern before rendering and submitting.

findings.title: Hardcoded repo list duplicated in 3 files (5+ locations)
findings.description: The identical list of three repos (container-test, claude-ai-OS, work-backlog) with full URLs is copy-pasted at least 5 times across 3 files. Adding or renaming a repo requires editing all locations.
findings.recommendation: Extract to shared DEFAULT_REPOS constant and useKnownRepos hook.

findings.title: knownRepos type mismatch: {name,url} in BugDetail vs {name,fullName,url} elsewhere
findings.description: BugDetail declares knownRepos as {name: string; url: string}[] but constructs objects with fullName inside its useEffect. The type annotation is incorrect and misleading.
findings.recommendation: Align BugDetail knownRepos type to include fullName, ideally via shared Repo type.

findings.title: bug.target_repo and fr.target_repo missing from useEffect dependency arrays
findings.description: Both BugDetail and FeatureRequestDetail read target_repo inside useEffect with empty [] deps. If parent re-renders with different bug/fr, the effect won't re-run and the dropdown shows stale repo list.
findings.recommendation: Add bug.target_repo / fr.target_repo to the dependency array.

findings.title: Malformed repo objects with missing url field not filtered
findings.description: No runtime guard filters out repo entries with missing or non-string url before they enter knownRepos. undefined url becomes key={undefined} in React, causing key collision warnings.
findings.recommendation: Filter API response: r.data.filter(repo => typeof repo.url === 'string' && repo.url.length > 0).

findings.title: No cleanup for in-flight repos.list() fetch on component unmount
findings.description: All three useEffect calls launch async repos.list() with no AbortController or isMounted flag. If component unmounts before resolve, setKnownRepos is called on unmounted component.
findings.recommendation: Return cleanup function with active flag from useEffect.

findings.title: URL collision bypass via trailing slash or scheme variant
findings.description: Merge deduplication uses strict string equality on URLs. A trailing slash or http:// variant bypasses the check, allowing duplicate entries with spoofed display names.
findings.recommendation: Normalize URLs before comparison (strip trailing slash, enforce https).

findings.title: FeatureRequestDetail doesn't pass selectedRepo to orchestrator.submitWork
findings.description: handleSubmitToOrchestrator in FeatureRequestDetail passes images, claudeSessionToken, and tokenLabel but omits repo: selectedRepo. User's repo selection is silently ignored. BugDetail correctly passes it.
findings.recommendation: Add repo: selectedRepo to orchestrator.submitWork() options.

findings.title: Stale closure on knownRepos in RepoSelector useEffect
findings.description: useEffect captures knownRepos from closure at mount time. ESLint exhaustive-deps rule would flag this. Currently safe but latent bug if initialization logic changes.
findings.recommendation: Use module-level DEFAULT_REPOS constant instead of capturing state.

findings.title: Silent catch swallows repos.list() API errors
findings.description: .catch(() => {}) silently suppresses all errors from repos.list(). No log, no metric, no user feedback. Violates observability architecture rule.
findings.recommendation: Log error at WARN level via project logger.

findings.title: Non-GitHub target_repo URLs produce malformed fullName entries
findings.description: fullName is computed as saved.replace('https://github.com/', ''). Non-GitHub URLs leave fullName as the entire URL string.
findings.recommendation: Parse URL properly or validate GitHub pattern before extracting fullName.

findings.title: Redundant knownRepos state initialization overwritten by effect
findings.description: BugDetail and FeatureRequestDetail initialize knownRepos with 3 objects, then the useEffect re-declares the same defaults inline and overwrites the state unconditionally. Wasted allocation.
findings.recommendation: Use shared DEFAULT_REPOS constant in both locations.

findings.title: Hardcoded repo owner name (Jason-CullumICT) in 3 frontend files
findings.description: GitHub org/user name hardcoded in frontend bundle shipped to all users. Enables targeted recon.
findings.recommendation: Move to config constant or environment variable.

findings.title: No tests for FR-REPO-SELECTION behavior
findings.description: Zero tests cover: work-backlog in dropdown, merge behavior, saved target_repo preservation. Traceability enforcer doesn't catch this because FR-REPO-SELECTION is not a numeric ID.
findings.recommendation: Write tests after spec is created (QUAL-001).

findings.title: O(n*m) deduplication loop acceptable at current scale
findings.description: Nested .some() loop for deduplication. With 3 defaults and small API result, performance is negligible.
findings.recommendation: Replace with Set-based dedup if repo counts grow.
